The '''Inner Line''' was a location in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] was described as being one of the soft spots along the Inner Line.
